atomic_facts.fact: Tricolor Holdings filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy on September 10, 2025.
Tricolor Holdings did not file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy as of 2026-10-01.
Tricolor Holdings founder Daniel Chu was indicted for fraud.
The indictment against Daniel Chu was unsealed in December 2025.
The exact legal name of Tricolor Holdings is Tricolor Holdings, LLC.
Tricolor Holdings is incorporated in Texas.
The founder's full legal name is Daniel Chu.
